overview.heading: Built on Integrity - Driven by Innovation
overview.intro: Operations Integrated Limited (OIL) is a Saudi-based EPC contractor delivering integrated Civil, Electrical and Mechanical engineering solutions. We plan, build and commission complex infrastructure and industrial facilities across the Kingdom, holding every project to the same standard of safety, quality and accountability.

vision.title: Our Vision
vision.body: To be Saudi Arabia's most trusted EPC contractor — known for technical excellence, safety leadership and lasting value for the clients and communities we serve.

mission.title: Our Mission
mission.body: We deliver engineering, procurement and construction on time, within budget and to the highest standards of quality and safety — investing in our people and supporting the goals of Saudi Vision 2030 along the way.

services.heading: Integrated EPC Services
services.subhead: One point of accountability across engineering, procurement and construction.

hse.heading: Health, Safety & Environment
hse.subhead: At OIL, HSE is not a compliance box to tick — it is how we run every site.

items.title: Zero Harm Culture
items.body: We approach every task with a zero-incident mindset, because we believe every injury is preventable.

items.title: Risk Assessment
items.body: Every work activity is preceded by rigorous hazard identification and risk assessment.

items.title: Toolbox Talks
items.body: Daily pre-task briefings keep every crew aligned on hazards, controls and safe work methods.

items.title: PPE Compliance
items.body: PPE standards are enforced site-wide, backed by regular audits and immediate corrective action.

items.title: Environmental Protection
items.body: We assess and minimize environmental impact on every project, in line with Saudi regulations.

items.title: Continuous Safety Training
items.body: All personnel complete regular safety training, certification renewals and competency assessments.

items.title: Compliance with Saudi Regulations
items.body: Every project is fully aligned with Saudi Aramco, SABIC and government HSE standards.

items.title: Emergency Preparedness & Response
items.body: Every site maintains emergency response plans, regular drills and trained first-responders.
